actions.description: Create a comment on a record or list entry in Attio.
actions.name: create-comment

format.description: The format of the comment content. Must be "plaintext".

content.description: The content of the comment. Workspace members can be mentioned using their email address.

type.description: The type of actor. Must be workspace-member.

id.description: The ID of the workspace member. Example: "641ecd33-0a48-4b7b-ba48-bbb7a649a8ee"

author.description: The workspace member who wrote this comment.

thread_id.description: If responding to an existing thread, the ID of that thread. Example: "aa1dc1d9-93ac-4c6c-987e-16b6eea9aab2"

record.description: Target record for the comment. Required if thread_id and entry are not provided.

object.description: The slug or ID of the object. Example: "people" or "30ff61f7-6b37-414e-8d6f-fb42f963e996"

record_id.description: The ID of the record. Example: "4c6ade84-19c7-4581-95aa-b1d5f4571c25"

entry.description: Target list entry for the comment. Required if thread_id and record are not provided.

list.description: The slug or ID of the list. Example: "39723680-f534-4fe7-ab80-c5278e20e37b"

entry_id.description: The ID of the entry. Example: "e9a7b33a-6dfc-483d-9a3b-fbc20068c162"

created_at.description: Optional ISO timestamp to backdate the comment. Defaults to current time.

workspace_id.description: The ID of the workspace the comment belongs to.

thread_id.description: The ID of the thread the comment belongs to.

content_plaintext.description: The plaintext content of the comment.

record_id.description: The ID of the record the comment belongs to.

object_id.description: The ID of the object the record belongs to.

record.description: The record the comment belongs to.

entry_id.description: The ID of the entry the comment belongs to.

list_id.description: The ID of the list the entry belongs to.

entry.description: The entry the comment belongs to, null for comments on records.

id.description: The ID of the actor who resolved this comment.

type.description: The type of actor who resolved this comment.

resolved_by.description: The actor that resolved this comment.

id.description: The ID of the actor who wrote this comment.

type.description: The type of actor who wrote this comment.

actions.description: Create a list entry in Attio by adding a record to a list
actions.name: create-list-entry

list.description: A UUID or slug identifying the list. Example: "seed_list_1" or "39723680-f534-4fe7-ab80-c5278e20e37b"

parent_record_id.description: A UUID identifying the record to add to the list. Example: "4c6ade84-19c7-4581-95aa-b1d5f4571c25"

parent_object.description: A UUID or slug identifying the object that the parent record belongs to. Example: "people" or "30ff61f7-6b37-414e-8d6f-fb42f963e996"

entry_values.description: Map of attribute keys (api_slug or attribute_id) to values. For multi-select attributes, use an array of values.

actions.description: Create a list in Attio.
actions.name: create-list

name.description: The human-readable name of the list. Example: "Enterprise Sales"

api_slug.description: A unique, human-readable slug to access the list through API calls. Should be formatted in snake case. Example: "enterprise_sales"

parent_object.description: A UUID or slug to identify the allowed object type for records added to this list. Example: "people"

workspace_access.description: The level of access granted to all members of the workspace for this list. Pass null to keep the list private.

workspace_member_id.description: A UUID to identify the workspace member to grant access to. Example: "50cf242c-7fa3-4cad-87d0-75b1af71c57b"

level.description: The level of access to the list.

workspace_member_access.description: The level of access granted to specific workspace members for this list. Pass an empty array to grant access to no workspace members.

workspace_member_id.description: A UUID to identify the workspace member to grant access to. Example: "50cf242c-7fa3-4cad-87d0-75b1af71c57b"

level.description: The level of access to the list.

actions.description: Create a note in Attio.
actions.name: create-note

parent_object.description: The ID or slug of the parent object the note belongs to. Example: "people"

parent_record_id.description: The ID of the parent record the note belongs to. Example: "891dcbfc-9141-415d-9b2a-2238a6cc012d"

title.description: The note title. The title is plaintext only and has no formatting.

format.description: The format of the note content.

content.description: The main content of the note, formatted according to the format field.

meeting_id.description: An optional ID to associate this note with a meeting.

actions.description: Create a custom object in Attio
actions.name: create-object

api_slug.description: A unique, human-readable slug to access the object through URLs and API calls. Should be formatted in snake case. Example: "people"

singular_noun.description: The singular form of the object's name. Example: "Person"

plural_noun.description: The plural form of the object's name. Example: "People"

id.description: The UUID of the created object

api_slug.description: The API slug of the object

singular_noun.description: The singular noun of the object

plural_noun.description: The plural noun of the object

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the object was created

actions.description: Create a record in Attio
actions.name: create-record

actions.description: Create a task in Attio.
actions.name: create-task

content.description: The text content of the task. Example: "Follow up on current software solutions"

format.description: The format of the task content. Only "plaintext" is supported.

deadline_at.description: The deadline of the task, in ISO 8601 format. Example: "2023-01-01T15:00:00.000000000Z"

is_completed.description: Whether the task has been completed. Defaults to false.

target_object.description: The ID or slug of the parent object the task refers to. Example: "people"

target_record_id.description: The ID of the parent record the task refers to. Example: "891dcbfc-9141-415d-9b2a-2238a6cc012d"

assignees.description: Workspace members assigned to this task.

referenced_actor_type.description: The actor type of the task assignee. Only workspace-member actors can be assigned to tasks.

referenced_actor_id.description: The ID of the actor assigned to this task. Example: "50cf242c-7fa3-4cad-87d0-75b1af71c57b"

actions.description: Create a webhook in Attio.
actions.name: create-webhook

target_url.description: URL where the webhook events will be delivered to. Example: "https://example.com/webhook"

event_type.description: Type of event the webhook is subscribed to. Example: "note.created"

filter.description: Filters to determine whether the webhook event should be sent. Use null for no filter.

subscriptions.description: One or more events the webhook is subscribed to.

workspace_id.description: The ID of the workspace the webhook belongs to.
